shared_elements: low-relief carved figural scene on a rectangular panel
patterned/textured infill areas (feathers vs brickwork courses)
justification: Both are shallow relief panels with strictly profile figures and dense repetitive surface patterning (feather rows in A, brick coursing and crenellation in B), and both share a convention of a single unframed rectangular field. But the depicted content differs entirely: A shows one large-scale bird-headed winged being filling the panel, while B shows a small-scale multi-figure siege narrative with fortified walls, towers, an arched gate and archers on a wheeled engine.
